# Detection of API Endpoints and Router Patterns (FastAPI/Flask)

Recognizes common web routing patterns in Python (FastAPI, Flask) to extract API endpoint observations, including HTTP verb, path, handler, and router. Identifies router definitions and mounts for normalized route composition. This supports analysis of API structure and route organization in modern Python web applications.
